title: Lighthouse with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rocky base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='32' ry='8' fill='#5a6a8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='89' rx='28' ry='6' fill='#7a8aaa'/>

  <!-- lighthouse body -->
  <path d='M36 86 L38 38 L62 38 L64 86 Z' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- white stripes -->
  <path d='M37.5 48 L62.5 48 L62.8 56 L37.2 56 Z' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <path d='M37 68 L63 68 L63.3 76 L36.7 76 Z' fill='#fff5e0'/>

  <!-- gallery / railing -->
  <rect x='34' y='34' width='32' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='36' y='30' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <!-- lamp room -->
  <rect x='40' y='18' width='20' height='13' rx='2' fill='#fff5e0'/>
  <!-- light glowing inside -->
  <rect x='44' y='21' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- lamp room frame -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='31' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- roof -->
  <path d='M36 19 L50 6 L64 19 Z' fill='#e8505b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='2.5' fill='#ffd166'/>

  <!-- smiling face on body -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <path d='M44 63 Q50 69 56 63' stroke='#3a3a5c' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- light beams radiating from lamp -->
  <path d='M40 24 L20 12 L20 20 Z' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M60 24 L80 12 L80 20 Z' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- little grass tufts -->
  <path d='M20 90 Q22 84 24 90' stroke='#6bcb77' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 90 Q78 84 80 90' stroke='#6bcb77' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
